name: Riko
source:
A maintenance support tech, assigned to Dollhouse by GL to troubleshoot minor biot issues. Beginning with a mere biot fascination, she sees herself as a biot doctor and is focused on doing her part in helping biots in society one step at a time.

Likes: Having a good laugh, being organized, helping others, hot chocolate
Dislikes: When information is beyond her clearance level, lack of punctuality

Age: ???
